items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: I heard Bessie Smith in person.

ctx.x: But Bessie you heard definitely, ma'am.
I heard Bessie in person, yeah. I heard Bessie Smith in person. And all these others I haven't been around to them, you know what I mean?
Well how did Bessie compare with Ma Rainey? Would she sing like her or different or?
